name: fmdemod
comment: Sig: x = fmdemod(y, fc, fs, freqdev[, ini_phase]). Frequency demodulator (inverse of fmmod): x = [0; diff(unwrap(angle(hilbert(y).*exp(-1j*(2*pi*fc*t+ini_phase)))))]*fs/(2*pi*freqdev). Fingerprint: fmdemod(fmmod(cos(2*pi*t),10,100,5),10,100,5) -> mf(2)=0.9977423314, mf(3)=0.9918940853, mf(50)=-0.9976932393. Depends on the length-N hilbert (bugs/signal/hilbert-nonpow2 fix). Verified vs MATLAB R2025b. Fixes the fmdemod part of bugs/comm/analog-demodulators.
